brief: Pad at the start to a length
description: Pad the <dataType> value at the start with fillString until it is maxLength code points long, as ECMAScript s.padStart() does. Lengths are code points, not UTF-16 units. Unlike ECMAScript, an empty fillString when padding is needed is an error, not a quiet return of a shorter value.

parameters.description: The length of the result in code points, at most 1,000,000. If it is not more than the length of value, value is returned (as a string).
parameters.name: maxLength

parameters.description: The text to pad with, repeated and cut to fit (by code point). The default is one space. An empty fillString is an error when padding is needed.
parameters.name: fillString

returns.description: The padded value, as a string.

errorsThrown.reason: fillString is empty and value is shorter than maxLength
